name: Juten Prime
slug: Juten Prime is an original keeper of the keystones whose ancient traditions yield when one of Mother’s children appears.
description: Juten Prime is one of the original keepers of the keystones. He is associated with the ancient traditions and events surrounding the keystones and their keepers. He had previously discussed with Plymouth Gawater what would happen if one of Mother’s children appeared, indicating that such an event was significant enough to supersede existing preparations and alter the expected course of events.

log.summary: Juten Prime stepped back alongside Kit Anger and allowed the ceremony to proceed. He had previously discussed with Plymouth what would happen if one of Mother’s children appeared, and the appearance of such a child was understood to supersede the party’s prior preparations and require events to unfold according to their natural course.
notes: Steps back with Kit Anger and allows the ceremony to proceed.

log.summary: Juten Prime approves Plymouth Gawater accompanying Walker’s expedition to investigate keystone usage and locate the Dragon Rider training grounds, and agrees to safeguard the two keystones the party is leaving behind. He will continue investigating the ruined site and exchange information with the party, noting that Plymouth may need to return to verify the group’s findings. Juten reports that the area’s former libraries and archives have been heavily damaged or destroyed by both raiding and natural degradation, and that the party has explored only roughly the top third of the mountain.
